briefing.text: Anthropic's IPO filing says it may soon reach its threshold for self-improving AI.
AMD posted record $13.4 billion revenue and forecast about $17 billion next quarter.
Bethesda named The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel, its first teaser since 2018.
Nvidia reportedly told cloud partners to sell mostly to non-Chinese customers.
Ramayana: Part 1 opens November 5 with over ₹63 crore in global advance sales.

stories.title: GTA VI pre-loads open November 10 and the game needs 212GB
stories.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI can be pre-loaded from November 10 ahead of its November 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
stories.why: It is the most anticipated game in years and will dominate the holiday season.
stories.happened: Kotaku reports a 212GB install, about a third of a base PS5's storage. Xbox pre-loads start at 7 p.m. ET on November 9, and boxed codes can pre-load from November 12. New Zealand gets it first, on November 18 UTC.
stories.next: Watch for review timing and launch-day server load as release nears.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited more than a decade for a new mainline GTA.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Its 212GB install will fill a big part of many consoles.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches right before the holiday shopping season.

stories.background: Rockstar Games makes Grand Theft Auto. GTA V, from 2013, is one of the best-selling games ever.

meme.top: GTA VI needs 212GB
meme.bottom: your other games have been informed
meme.take: GTA VI is 15 days out and already asking the rest of your library to move out.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO filing warns it may be close to self-improving AI
stories.summary: Anthropic's amended S-1 says future models may soon meet its internal threshold for dramatically accelerated, AI-driven research progress.
stories.why: Labs have long debated recursive self-improvement; this is a frontier lab raising it in a legal filing.
stories.happened: Anthropic says no current model has crossed the threshold and it is still assessing the data. It also says it may not spot sharp acceleration until after it happens, and does not expect to let Claude build new frontier models without human supervision.
stories.next: Watch for changes to Anthropic's Responsible Scaling Policy and how other labs respond.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A frontier lab is flagging self-improving AI as a risk in an IPO filing.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The filing says using AI to build better AI could pose a considerable safety risk.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands weeks before Anthropic's planned stock market listing.

stories.background: Recursive self-improvement means AI speeding up the research that produces better AI. Anthropic makes Claude.

meme.top: Anthropic warned investors
meme.bottom: the product may improve itself
meme.take: This IPO season's strangest risk factor: the product may stop needing the staff.

stories.title: Bethesda finally names The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel in a new teaser
stories.summary: A short Bethesda Game Studios 40th anniversary video ended with the first new Elder Scrolls VI teaser since 2018, confirming the name Sentinel.
stories.why: Elder Scrolls fans have waited more than eight years for any update on the Skyrim follow-up.
stories.happened: Todd Howard presented the video. The teaser shows a scroll buried in sand. Sentinel is a city in Hammerfell, widely believed to be the setting, Kotaku notes. There is still no release date.
stories.next: Watch for a full reveal or a release window from Bethesda.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Skyrim remains one of the best-selling games ever.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The game was first announced at E3 in 2018.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It marks 40 years of Bethesda Game Studios.

stories.background: The Elder Scrolls is Bethesda's fantasy role-playing series. The last main entry, Skyrim, came out in 2011.

meme.top: Elder Scrolls VI has a name now
meme.bottom: the release date is still sand
meme.take: Bethesda shared a name after eight years. At this pace, the date is a 2030s story.

stories.title: Ocarina of Time remake launches November 5 with reviews due this week
stories.summary: Nintendo's Switch 2 rebuild of Ocarina of Time launches Thursday, with review scores expected around midweek.
stories.why: Ocarina of Time is one of the most celebrated games ever made.
stories.happened: The original director told Kotaku that fixing the Water Temple was overdue homework. TheGamer reported about 60,000 Amazon US pre-orders over a month, against about 11,000 for GTA VI. The N64 original holds Metacritic's top score of 99.
stories.next: Watch for review scores and whether it can match the original's legacy.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The 1998 original is a landmark of 3D game design.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: It has outpaced GTA VI in Amazon US physical pre-orders.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrives two weeks before GTA VI.

stories.background: Ocarina of Time first came out on the Nintendo 64 in 1998. The Switch 2 is Nintendo's newest console.

meme.top: The Water Temple got fixed
meme.bottom: 28 years later, apology accepted
meme.take: Nintendo has finally addressed the Water Temple, a complaint old enough to rent a car.

stories.title: AMD posts a record $13.4 billion quarter and guides to about $17 billion
stories.summary: AMD's third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $13.4 billion, led by a record $8.5 billion from data center chips, up 97%.
stories.why: AMD is Nvidia's main rival in AI chips, and its results show how fast AI spending is still growing.
stories.happened: Non-GAAP earnings were $2.09 a share, up 74%. AMD guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion, plus or minus 3%. Lisa Su said she expects growth to accelerate further. The stock had fallen nearly 20% in three sessions before the report.
stories.next: Watch for how the stock trades on the guidance and for updates on AMD's AI chip customers.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Fourth-quarter guidance implies about 66% growth from a year earlier.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AMD is the main challenger to Nvidia in AI accelerators.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows a three-day sell-off in chip stocks.

stories.background: AMD designs processors and graphics chips for PCs, game consoles and data centers.

meme.top: AMD had its best quarter ever
meme.bottom: and promised a better one next
meme.take: AMD beat its own forecast and raised the bar, which is how chipmakers say good morning now.

stories.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon edges past Claude Opus 5.5 on a key AI leaderboard
stories.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon scored 59 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, one point above Claude Opus 5.5, at lower cost per task.
stories.why: Top spot on the main leaderboards keeps changing hands between Google, Anthropic and OpenAI.
stories.happened: Tom's Hardware says it also leads a knowledge and hallucination test with 54, though it trails Opus 5.5 at coding. It costs about $7.76 per index task. Google is first offering it to selected cyber defenders before wider access.
stories.next: Watch for when developers get access and whether rival labs answer with new models.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It moves Google one point ahead of Anthropic on a widely watched index.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Its cost per task is about 23% lower than Opus 5.5's.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Google is holding back a wide release while it tunes cybersecurity guardrails.

stories.background: Gemini is Google's family of AI models. Artificial Analysis is an independent firm that benchmarks them.

meme.top: Google took first place by one point
meme.bottom: and kept most people off the podium
meme.take: Gemini 4 Carbon leads the chart, and for now mostly cyber defenders are allowed to use it.

stories.title: Ramayana: Part 1 opens November 5 with over ₹63 crore in global advance sales
stories.summary: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash, has about ₹63.48 crore in worldwide advance bookings.
stories.why: It is one of the most expensive and anticipated Indian films in years, based on a central Hindu epic.
stories.happened: Sacnilk figures cited by The Week put India pre-sales at ₹34.01 crore and overseas at about $3.5 million, including $2.58 million in North America. Paid previews run November 4.
stories.next: Watch for its opening-day total in India and its first weekend in North America.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Pre-sales cover more than 23,000 shows in India.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It pairs Ranbir Kapoor with Kannada star Yash.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The Ramayana is one of India's best-known stories.

stories.background: The Ramayana is an ancient Sanskrit epic about the prince Rama. Nitesh Tiwari directed Dangal.

meme.top: An epic thousands of years old
meme.bottom: still sold out the preview shows
meme.take: Ramayana has spoilers that are thousands of years old and pre-sales of ₹63 crore anyway.

stories.title: Anthropic's updated IPO filing shows about $17 billion in third-quarter revenue
stories.summary: An amended S-1 shows Anthropic's Q3 revenue at about $17 billion, up roughly elevenfold, with a $23.3 billion net loss.
stories.why: It is the clearest look yet at the finances of a frontier AI lab weeks before a planned listing.
stories.happened: Nine-month revenue reached $33.24 billion. CNBC says the Q3 loss came mainly from non-cash changes in the value of convertible notes and derivatives. Purchase commitments and leases total about $895.4 billion.
stories.next: Watch for the final IPO price range and how investors react to the commitments.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Quarterly revenue of about $17 billion is reported to be up roughly 1,127% from a year earlier.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Compute commitments and leases add up to almost $900 billion.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The filing lands weeks before a planned November Nasdaq listing.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models, founded in 2021.

meme.top: Anthropic made $17 billion
meme.bottom: and lost $23 billion on paper
meme.take: Anthropic's quarter shows you can earn $17 billion and still need an accountant to explain it.

stories.title: Nvidia is said to require cloud partners to sell mostly to non-Chinese customers
stories.summary: The Financial Times reports Nvidia told cloud customers to sell at least 51% of their services to non-Chinese companies.
stories.why: It would tighten Chinese access to top AI chips through overseas cloud providers.
stories.happened: The reported rule applies to Nvidia's data center cloud partners worldwide, according to the FT's sources. It comes as US limits on chip sales to China remain tight. Nvidia has not publicly detailed the policy.
stories.next: Watch for official comment from Nvidia and reaction from cloud providers in Asia.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Cloud providers with many Chinese clients could lose access to chips.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Chip access is a central front in US-China tech competition.

stories.background: Nvidia makes the graphics processors that power most AI training and is the world's most valuable chipmaker.

meme.top: Nvidia set a new rule for its clients
meme.bottom: the rule is mostly about geography
meme.take: Nvidia now wants cloud companies to check where their customers are before they check out.

stories.title: Anthropic is said to seek up to $3.5 billion from Japan as IPO price talks go on
stories.summary: Bloomberg says Anthropic wants up to $3.5 billion from Japanese investors in its IPO, as big funds reportedly push for a $1.5 trillion value.
stories.why: The price will set the tone for every other AI company hoping to go public.
stories.happened: The Wall Street Journal reported that institutional investors want a valuation of about $1.5 trillion to $1.6 trillion, below earlier $2 trillion talk. Bloomberg separately reports the Japan tranche of up to $3.5 billion. Anthropic has not commented on terms.
stories.next: Watch for the official price range in Anthropic's roadshow filings.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $400 billion gap between targets is larger than most listed companies.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The talks come right after a week of falling tech stocks.

stories.background: An IPO valuation is set by bankers and big investors before shares start trading.

meme.top: Investors asked for a discount
meme.bottom: and the discount is $400 billion
meme.take: Anthropic's investors are haggling, at a scale where haggling has its own GDP.

stories.title: Godzilla Minus Zero arrives November 6 with a 92% critics' score
stories.summary: Toho's sequel to Godzilla Minus One opens in North America on November 6, with early reviews at 92% on Rotten Tomatoes.
stories.why: Minus One was a surprise global hit and an Oscar winner, so the sequel carries big expectations.
stories.happened: Takashi Yamazaki returns as writer, director and visual effects supervisor, Forbes reports. One box office forecast puts its opening at about $36.2 million, ahead of the animated The Cat in the Hat.
stories.next: Watch for whether it tops the weekend box office against The Cat in the Hat.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Yamazaki's Minus One won the Oscar for visual effects.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Early reviews call it bigger than the first film.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It opens the same weekend as a new Dr. Seuss film.

stories.background: Toho is the Japanese studio that created Godzilla in 1954.

meme.top: Godzilla is back for another film
meme.bottom: Tokyo has not been asked
meme.take: Godzilla Minus Zero has strong reviews, which is little comfort to the fictional buildings.

stories.title: Red Hat patches a 9.8-rated Linux flaw that an AI model exploited
stories.summary: Red Hat has fixed CVE-2026-98432, a critical Linux kernel TCP bug, while Ubuntu's main fixes are still in testing.
stories.why: The flaw allows remote root access on some servers, and an AI wrote a working exploit for it.
stories.happened: The Hacker News says Anthropic reported in October that an unreleased Claude research model wrote a remote root exploit for servers with an MPTCP listener. The bug dates back to Linux 4.4. Debian, SUSE and Amazon Linux shipped fixes in October.
stories.next: Watch for Ubuntu's general release of the fix and whether attacks appear in the wild.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: It can give attackers root access with no login needed.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: An AI model wrote a working exploit for a critical kernel bug.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Linux runs most of the world's servers.

stories.background: The Linux kernel is the core of the Linux operating system. CVSS scores rate bug severity from 0 to 10.

meme.top: An AI found a way into Linux
meme.bottom: and politely told everyone first
meme.take: The most dangerous Linux bug this month was exploited by an AI, which then filed a report.

stories.title: Ubisoft is reported to have bid for Arkane, the studio making Marvel's Blade
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports Ubisoft has submitted a bid for Microsoft's Arkane, the Dishonored studio, as Xbox looks to sell it.
stories.why: It would decide the fate of Marvel's Blade and one of gaming's most respected studios.
stories.happened: Microsoft is also said to be exploring a sale back to Arkane's management, and a closure is possible if no deal is reached. A Microsoft spokesperson said it continues to explore options ahead of a December deadline, Kotaku reports.
stories.next: Watch for Microsoft's decision before its December deadline.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Ubisoft is reported to be one of several possible buyers.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: A closure is possible if no buyer is found.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Arkane made Dishonored, Prey and Deathloop.

stories.background: Arkane is a French studio owned by Microsoft through Bethesda. Ubisoft is a French game publisher.

meme.top: Ubisoft wants to buy a studio
meme.bottom: while still restructuring itself
meme.take: Ubisoft is restructuring and shopping at once, like moving house mid-renovation.

stories.title: Apple reports a record $114.5 billion quarter in Ternus's first results as CEO
stories.summary: Apple's fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rose 12% to $114.5 billion, with iPhone up 17% and China sales up 21%.
stories.why: Apple's results show whether people are still upgrading phones in an AI-heavy market.
stories.happened: Services hit a record $31.57 billion and net income was $30.71 billion. Gross margins fell, largely on memory costs, and TechCrunch says Ternus expects those costs to keep rising into December. The shares fell about 2% on Tuesday.
stories.next: Watch for holiday-quarter demand for the iPhone Duo and the new Macs.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is John Ternus's first earnings report as Apple's CEO.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: iPhone revenue alone reached $57.58 billion.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Apple is among the world's most valuable companies.

stories.background: Apple's fiscal fourth quarter covers July to September and includes the first weeks of new iPhone sales.

meme.top: Apple had its best quarter ever
meme.bottom: and the memory chips sent an invoice
meme.take: Apple earned $30 billion in three months, and the memory makers want a word.

stories.title: WIRED finds over 400 ordinary-looking AI apps hiding abusive deepfake tools
stories.summary: A WIRED investigation tied more than 400 apps and sites, some in Apple's and Google's stores, to one network offering sexual deepfake features.
stories.why: It shows how harmful AI tools can slip past app store review by posing as harmless ones.
stories.happened: The apps posed as services such as pet portrait generators and were reported to have over 350,000 downloads. Apple removed 19 apps after WIRED contacted it, and Meta took action against linked ad accounts and pages.
stories.next: Watch for further removals by Apple and Google and any response from regulators.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 400 apps and websites were linked to one network.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Nonconsensual deepfakes cause real harm to the people depicted.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Some of the apps passed review in the major app stores.

stories.background: Deepfakes are AI-generated images or videos that make it look like a real person did something they did not.

meme.top: App stores reviewed these apps
meme.bottom: and approved the disguise
meme.take: A WIRED probe suggests app review was mostly reviewing the icons.

stories.title: Lupin Part 4 leads Netflix's non-English chart with 10.8 million views
stories.summary: The French heist series' fourth part topped Netflix's non-English TV list for the week to November 1, with viewing hours up about 71%.
stories.why: Lupin is one of Netflix's most successful non-English shows, and its return pulled older seasons back up.
stories.happened: Part 4 logged 65 million hours in its second week, What's on Netflix reports. Parts 1, 2 and 3 all re-entered the top 10 as viewers caught up.
stories.next: Watch for its third-week figures and any news of a fifth part.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Earlier parts charted again alongside the new one.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It drew 10.8 million views in one week.

stories.background: Lupin stars Omar Sy as a gentleman thief inspired by the Arsène Lupin novels.

meme.top: Lupin returned for a new heist
meme.bottom: and stole back three old seasons
meme.take: Lupin Part 4 is so good at theft it took viewers from its own back catalogue.

stories.title: Phantom Blade Zero sells over 4 million copies in three days
stories.summary: S-GAME says its action game Phantom Blade Zero sold more than 4 million copies in 72 hours after its October 29 launch.
stories.why: It is another sign that big Chinese-made action games can sell worldwide.
stories.happened: The game peaked at over 830,000 concurrent players on Steam. About 90% of nearly 50,000 Steam reviews are positive. It launched on PC and PS5.
stories.next: Watch for updated sales figures and how long it holds its Steam player count.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Four million copies in three days is a top-tier launch.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: It follows Black Myth: Wukong as another big Chinese action game.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Pre-orders reportedly topped Steam's global charts.

stories.background: S-GAME is a Chinese developer. Phantom Blade Zero is its first major console and PC release.

meme.top: Phantom Blade Zero sold 4 million
meme.bottom: the zero was just branding
meme.take: Phantom Blade Zero moved 4 million copies in three days, so the zero was clearly decorative.

stories.title: Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum in a $115 billion all-stock deal
stories.summary: Marvell will pay 4.5 of its shares for each Lumentum share, valuing the optical-parts maker at about $115 billion including debt.
stories.why: It is a huge bet that AI data centers will need far more high-speed optical links.
stories.happened: Both stocks fell on Monday: Lumentum 18.6% and Marvell 12.7%, StockTitan reports. Marvell holders will own 67% of the combined company. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2028.
stories.next: Watch for regulatory reviews and how shareholders of both companies vote.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It is reported as the largest merger of two public tech companies.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI clusters rely on optical links to move data between chips.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The deal dwarfs Marvell's $10 billion Inphi purchase in 2021.

stories.background: Marvell designs chips for data centers and networking. Lumentum makes lasers and optical components.

meme.top: Marvell paid $115 billion for Lumentum
meme.bottom: both stocks celebrated by falling
meme.take: Marvell and Lumentum merged, and investors responded by marking down both companies.

stories.title: Anthropic confirms Claude Code limits meant to stop cloning specific games
stories.summary: Anthropic says Claude Code now has instructions to avoid recreating specific existing games, citing its intellectual property policy.
stories.why: Developers want coding agents with few limits, while rights holders worry about easy copies of their work.
stories.happened: Tom's Hardware reports that some developers say Opus 5.5 is also refusing legitimate reverse-engineering tasks. Anthropic has not confirmed how broad the new limits are.
stories.next: Watch for whether Anthropic clarifies what counts as cloning and what stays allowed.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Some developers say legitimate work is being blocked.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI coding agents can now build working games from short prompts.

stories.background: Claude Code is Anthropic's AI coding agent, used by developers to write and edit software.

meme.top: You can ask Claude for a game
meme.bottom: just not one that already exists
meme.take: Claude Code will still build you a game, as long as nobody has heard of it.

stories.title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil passes $400 million worldwide
stories.summary: Sony's Resident Evil reboot has crossed $400 million worldwide and is reported to reach digital purchase and rental on November 3.
stories.why: A video game horror film reaching this level shows how strong both genres are at the box office.
stories.happened: It passed Cregger's Weapons and Resident Evil: The Final Chapter at $312 million. Dread Central reported a November 3 digital release for purchase and premium rental, which Sony had not confirmed when it was reported.
stories.next: Watch for its first digital sales charts and any sequel news from Sony.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Cregger is coming off the hits Barbarian and Weapons.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Resident Evil is one of gaming's best-known horror series.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Horror has been one of the strongest genres in cinemas this year.

stories.background: Resident Evil began as a Capcom video game in 1996 and became a long-running film series.

meme.top: A zombie film made $400 million
meme.bottom: now it is coming to your sofa
meme.take: Resident Evil is the rare outbreak everyone involved would happily repeat.

stories.title: Indie developers say slow Steam reviews are delaying their launches
stories.summary: Developers told Kotaku that Valve's game reviews took two to three weeks in October, and they suspect a flood of AI-made games.
stories.why: Small studios depend on hitting launch dates, and Steam is the biggest PC store.
stories.happened: About 4,000 games came out on Steam in October, and nearly half disclosed some use of generative AI. Valve said it is fully aware of the situation but has not explained the delays. Its usual review time is three to five days.
stories.next: Watch for Valve's promised blog post explaining the review backlog.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More games launched on Steam by mid-October than in all of 2025.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Late launches can push small studios into money trouble.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Generative AI has made games much faster to produce.

stories.background: Valve runs Steam and checks every game before it can be released on the store.

meme.top: Steam is reviewing 4,000 games a month
meme.bottom: yours is somewhere in the pile
meme.take: Indie developers are learning that the hardest boss this year is the Steam review queue.

stories.title: Netflix's Matthew Perry documentary debuts at No. 1 with 9.5 million views
stories.summary: The One About Matthew Perry led Netflix's English TV chart for the week to November 1 with 9.5 million views.
stories.why: Perry's life and death drew huge attention, and Friends remains one of TV's most watched shows.
stories.happened: What's on Netflix reports 29 million hours viewed in its first week, ahead of Nobody Wants This season 3. Directed by Mary Robertson, it draws on interviews with Perry's sister and close friends.
stories.next: Watch for its second-week numbers against other celebrity documentaries.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Perry played Chandler Bing on Friends.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Friends still draws new viewers decades later.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Celebrity documentaries keep topping streaming charts.

stories.background: Matthew Perry starred in Friends from 1994 to 2004 and died in 2023 at 54.

meme.top: A documentary about Matthew Perry
meme.bottom: watched by 9.5 million people
meme.take: Netflix's Perry documentary topped the chart, and its plain, careful tone suits it.

stories.title: Supermarkets in five European countries report suspected hacks of their freezers
stories.summary: Supermarkets in Belgium, Sweden and three other European countries reported fridge and freezer temperature spikes from suspected cyberattacks.
stories.why: Attacks on everyday systems like refrigeration can waste food and disrupt shops directly.
stories.happened: Bloomberg describes it as a new wave of suspected hacks on refrigeration controls. The culprits have not been identified, and it is not clear whether the incidents are linked.
stories.next: Watch for findings on who was behind the attacks and how the systems were reached.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Connected building systems are often poorly protected.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Shops in five countries reported problems.

stories.background: Many large stores run refrigeration through internet-connected control systems that can be managed remotely.

meme.top: Hackers went after supermarkets
meme.bottom: and targeted the ice cream
meme.take: Europe's latest cyberattack hit the frozen aisle, where the ransom is measured in melted peas.

stories.title: Apple's first touchscreen Macs and an OLED iPad mini go on sale Friday
stories.summary: Apple releases five products on November 6, including OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros from $2,899 and an OLED iPad mini at $699.
stories.why: Touchscreen Macs are a big change after years of Apple resisting them.
stories.happened: MacRumors lists a $1,499 M6 iMac, a $1,999 M6 MacBook Pro and 14- and 16-inch OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros. The iPad mini gets an 8.5-inch OLED screen and IP67 rating. Some touchscreen models ship in weeks.
stories.next: Watch for the first hands-on reviews of the touchscreen MacBook Pro.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: These are Apple's first touchscreen Macs.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: They land just ahead of the holiday shopping season.

stories.background: Apple long argued against touchscreens on Macs, keeping touch for the iPad and iPhone.

meme.top: Apple made a touchscreen Mac
meme.bottom: your screen now needs a cloth
meme.take: Apple's first touchscreen Mac arrives Friday, along with years of fingerprints.

stories.title: OpenAI signs four deals with Abu Dhabi covering government, energy and investment
stories.summary: OpenAI signed four agreements with Abu Dhabi spanning government services, energy operations and sovereign investment, Semafor reports.
stories.why: Gulf states are becoming major partners and funders for US AI companies.
stories.happened: Abu Dhabi says it wants to become the world's first fully AI-native government. Semafor says Sam Altman's visit came as OpenAI prepares for a possible IPO.
stories.next: Watch for details on how the agreements are funded and which services launch first.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Sovereign investment is one of the four areas covered.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Abu Dhabi wants AI running across its whole government.

stories.background: Abu Dhabi is the capital of the United Arab Emirates and has invested heavily in AI.

meme.top: A government wants to be AI-native
meme.bottom: the paperwork will be the first to go
meme.take: Abu Dhabi plans an AI-run government, which means the forms will finally fill themselves out.

stories.title: Jailer 2 passes ₹800 crore to become the top-grossing Tamil film
stories.summary: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has taken about ₹807 crore worldwide in 18 days, passing his own 2.0 as the biggest Tamil film ever.
stories.why: Rajinikanth is one of India's biggest stars, and records like this are closely followed.
stories.happened: Sacnilk figures cited by The Hollywood Reporter India put its India gross at ₹533.75 crore and overseas at ₹273.50 crore. It crossed ₹800 crore on its third Sunday. PVR INOX and Cinepolis did not screen the Hindi version.
stories.next: Watch for its final total and the date of its streaming release.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Rajinikanth has led Tamil cinema for decades.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is chasing 2.0, another Rajinikanth film.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About $81 million worldwide in 16 days.

stories.background: Jailer 2 is the sequel to the 2023 hit Jailer. Tamil cinema is based in Chennai in southern India.

meme.top: Rajinikanth broke a record
meme.bottom: previously held by Rajinikanth
meme.take: Jailer 2 beat the biggest Tamil film ever, also a Rajinikanth film, so nobody is upset.

stories.title: Mass Effect's N7 Day arrives weeks after EA shut down BioWare
stories.summary: BioWare appears to have lined up N7 Day merchandise before EA closed the studio, and fans are using the day for a Save Mass Effect push.
stories.why: BioWare made some of the best-loved role-playing games, and its closure shocked many players.
stories.happened: Kotaku says Youtooz teased Mass Effect figures and Insert Coin re-released a clothing line for the November 7 celebration. Fans plan to raise Steam player counts for the Legendary Edition. EA also cancelled the next Mass Effect.
stories.next: Watch for what EA does with the Mass Effect series and the N7 Day turnout on Steam.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The Mass Effect trilogy has a large, loyal fan base.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans are organising a campaign to show the series still matters.

stories.background: BioWare made Baldur's Gate, Mass Effect and Dragon Age. EA bought it in 2007.

meme.top: N7 Day is still on the calendar
meme.bottom: the studio that made it is not
meme.take: The Mass Effect merchandise arrived on time. The studio did not make it.

stories.title: OpenAI launches a program to cut data center power use when the grid is strained
stories.summary: OpenAI's Grid Protectors Program aims to reduce electricity demand from its future data center campuses during emergencies and extreme weather.
stories.why: Rising data center power demand is a growing political issue for the AI industry.
stories.happened: The Verge reports that a planned Georgia site could free up to 1,000 megawatts when needed. The site is still in development. Semafor reports hundreds of local and state moratorium efforts against data centers.
stories.next: Watch for which utilities sign up and whether the commitments ease local opposition.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: One planned site could give back up to 1,000 megawatts.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Opposition to data centers is growing in many communities.

stories.background: AI data centers draw huge amounts of electricity, which can strain local power grids at peak times.

meme.top: OpenAI promises to use less power
meme.bottom: on the days you need it most
meme.take: OpenAI will dial down its data centers in a heatwave, which is considerate of the heatwave.

stories.title: Xbox puts a Series X inside an alligator to hint at GTA VI without naming it
stories.summary: Xbox unveiled the Series X-BITE, a one-off console inside a five-foot animatronic alligator, offered through a sweepstakes.
stories.why: Sony reportedly holds GTA VI's marketing rights, so Xbox has to be creative to join the hype.
stories.happened: The alligator has a lit Xbox logo and a bitten controller in its jaws. Xbox's post says it is heading to Florida this November but never mentions GTA VI or Rockstar, Kotaku notes.
stories.next: Watch for more indirect GTA VI promotion from Xbox before November 19.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Sony reportedly has an exclusive GTA VI marketing deal.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrives about two weeks before GTA VI launches.

stories.background: GTA VI is set in a fictional version of Florida, a state well known for its alligators.

meme.top: Xbox is not allowed to say GTA VI
meme.bottom: so it built an alligator instead
meme.take: Xbox found a way to advertise GTA VI without saying GTA VI, and it has teeth.

stories.title: New Windows malware sends stolen data to Claude to rank victims by value
stories.summary: Researchers found an infostealer that feeds stolen personal and financial data to an AI model to judge which victims are worth the most.
stories.why: It shows criminals building AI into malware, not just using chatbots on the side.
stories.happened: Tom's Hardware reports the malware can switch to another model if one refuses, and keeps stealing data even if the AI step fails. It deletes itself after building its assessment.
stories.next: Watch for responses from AI companies on detecting this kind of misuse.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: AI ranking could help criminals target the most valuable victims.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Security researchers are finding more malware that calls AI models.

stories.background: An infostealer is malware that collects passwords, financial details and other data from an infected computer.

meme.top: The malware asked an AI for help
meme.bottom: and had a backup AI ready
meme.take: Even malware has a fallback plan for when its chatbot says no.

stories.title: SemiAnalysis's new GDPx test finds the best AI model scores 12%
stories.summary: GDPx tests frontier models on hard work in 11 fields, and Claude Opus 5.5 leads with 12.0%.
stories.why: Low scores on real work tasks are a check on the hype around AI replacing experts.
stories.happened: Gemini 4 Carbon scored 10.9% and GPT-6 Astra 9.6%. Every model scored 0% on finance and legal tasks. The fields include chip design, cybersecurity, biology and quant trading, and SemiAnalysis plans refreshes every 3-6 months.
stories.next: Watch for how the new models expected this month score on the next GDPx refresh.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: The three leading labs are separated by less than three points.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It targets expert-level work rather than quiz-style questions.

stories.background: SemiAnalysis is a research firm known for reporting on chips and AI infrastructure.

meme.top: The top AI model scored 12%
meme.bottom: and still topped the class
meme.take: The new AI benchmark is so hard the winning grade would get a student a meeting.

stories.title: Clayface leads the worldwide box office in its second weekend
stories.summary: DC Studios' Clayface topped the global chart with about $23 million, taking its worldwide total to about $83 million.
stories.why: It is a test of whether smaller, cheaper DC films can work under the new DC Studios plan.
stories.happened: Clayface placed second in North America behind You Can See Everything but led worldwide. Its global total reached about $83 million. It is DC Studios' first R-rated horror film.
stories.next: Watch for how it holds against Godzilla Minus Zero and The Cat in the Hat this weekend.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It has passed its reported $40 million budget.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It lost the top spot by about $200,000.

stories.background: Clayface is a Batman villain. The film is part of the DC Universe run by James Gunn and Peter Safran.

meme.top: Clayface came second at home
meme.bottom: and first everywhere else
meme.take: Clayface lost the domestic race and won the planet, a shape-shifter's idea of a fair result.

stories.title: World of Warcraft: Forever launches with over 1,000 new quests
stories.summary: Blizzard's new take on early Azeroth, World of Warcraft: Forever, launches on PC on November 4 with a level-60 cap.
stories.why: Classic-style WoW servers have drawn huge crowds, and this is Blizzard's biggest new spin on that era.
stories.happened: It adds more than 1,000 new quests, nine new dungeons and a new Skyborne race, dlcompare reports. Players need an active WoW subscription or game time.
stories.next: Watch for server queues and player numbers in launch week.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: It revisits the early years of the 2004 game.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It adds more than 1,000 quests and nine dungeons.

stories.background: World of Warcraft is Blizzard's long-running online role-playing game, launched in 2004.

meme.top: Blizzard rebuilt early Azeroth
meme.bottom: and added 1,000 quests to be sure
meme.take: WoW Forever is back for players who wanted 2004 again, plus a thousand extra chores.

stories.title: Oracle files to raise $20 billion in stock and bonds for its AI build-out
stories.summary: Oracle plans to sell $10 billion of new shares and $10 billion of bonds, and its stock closed down 8.8%.
stories.why: Oracle is one of the most heavily indebted players in the race to build AI data centers.
stories.happened: CNBC reports the raise was previewed at Oracle's investor day. Its debt stood at $125.34 billion as of late August. Credit default swaps on its debt have priced risk at junk-like levels.
stories.next: Watch for the pricing of the share sale and any move by credit rating agencies.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $20 billion raise is large even for Oracle.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Selling shares dilutes existing investors.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Several AI spenders are tapping debt markets at once.

stories.background: Oracle is a US database and cloud company that has become a major AI data center provider.

meme.top: Oracle needs $20 billion
meme.bottom: and has asked politely, twice
meme.take: Oracle is raising $20 billion in two flavors so investors can pick their favorite risk.

stories.title: Nobody Wants This season 3 slips to No. 2 with 7.2 million views
stories.summary: The romantic comedy drew 7.2 million views in its second week, behind the new Matthew Perry documentary.
stories.why: A comedy holding the top spot in its third season is rare for a streaming show.
stories.happened: What's on Netflix says season 3 has 13.4 million views over two weeks, against 26.2 million for season 1 and 18 million for season 2 over the same span. Its hours rose about 17% in week two.
stories.next: Watch for whether Netflix renews it for a fourth season.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Its first two seasons built a loyal audience.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrived in a week with few big new series.

stories.background: Nobody Wants This is a Netflix romantic comedy series that first premiered in 2024.

meme.top: The show is called Nobody Wants This
meme.bottom: 7.2 million people wanted this
meme.take: Netflix's romcom is cooling off, and 7.2 million people still want it.

stories.title: Salesforce is said to be buying contact-center AI maker Cresta for $2.7 billion
stories.summary: The Information reports Salesforce plans to acquire Cresta, which makes AI software for customer service centers, for about $2.7 billion.
stories.why: Customer service is one of the first jobs where businesses are paying for AI agents at scale.
stories.happened: The price comes from a person familiar with the deal, according to The Information. Cresta's software listens to calls and helps human agents in real time. Neither company had announced terms at the time of the report.
stories.next: Watch for an official announcement and regulatory filings.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A reported $2.7 billion is a large price for a startup.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Software giants are buying AI agent companies.

stories.background: Salesforce is the largest maker of customer relationship management software.

meme.top: Salesforce bought a call center AI
meme.bottom: your call is important to it
meme.take: Salesforce is reportedly paying $2.7 billion to make hold music feel more personal.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs pulls advanced AI coding tools from many traders and bankers
stories.summary: Goldman has restricted tools including Claude Code for many traders and bankers, leaving them largely to its engineers.
stories.why: A top bank stepping back from AI coding tools is a rare counterpoint to fast adoption.
stories.happened: The bank cited productivity and risk-management concerns, according to reports summarised by The Decoder. Engineers keep most of their access. Goldman has not said in detail what prompted the change.
stories.next: Watch for whether other banks review their AI coding tools in the same way.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Banks are cautious about AI tools touching client and trading systems.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Coding agents spread quickly beyond engineers this year.

stories.background: Goldman Sachs is one of the largest US investment banks. Copilot is Microsoft-owned GitHub's coding assistant.

meme.top: Goldman gave bankers coding agents
meme.bottom: then gave them back to the coders
meme.take: Goldman has decided that writing software should be done by the people paid to write software.

stories.title: Circana data shows Modern Warfare 4 launched with fewer console players than Black Ops 7
stories.summary: Modern Warfare 4 took 19% of US PlayStation play in launch week, against 23% for Black Ops 7, but did better on Steam.
stories.why: Call of Duty is a yearly bellwether, and it now faces GTA VI weeks after launch.
stories.happened: Circana's Mat Piscatella shared the data: 17% of worldwide Xbox play versus 29%, and 4.2% of US Steam play versus 1.5%. MP1st notes Black Ops 7 was also on Game Pass and last-gen consoles.
stories.next: Watch for November sales charts once GTA VI is out.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Last year Battlefield 6 outsold Black Ops 7 in the US.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: GTA VI arrives less than a month after its launch.

stories.background: Activision's Call of Duty is one of the best-selling game series. Microsoft owns Activision.

meme.top: Modern Warfare 4 did fine on PC
meme.bottom: and is now bracing for November 19
meme.take: Modern Warfare 4 had a decent launch, which in a GTA month counts as a strategic retreat.

stories.title: Palantir's US commercial revenue jumps 148% and passes government sales
stories.summary: Palantir's third-quarter revenue rose 96% to $2.31 billion, and it raised its full-year forecast to about $8.53 billion.
stories.why: Palantir has become a bellwether for whether companies are paying for AI software.
stories.happened: US commercial revenue reached $984 million, topping US government revenue of $953 million for the first time, CNBC reports. Net income was $1.13 billion. The shares were about 3% lower after hours.
stories.next: Watch for how the stock trades as investors weigh growth against its valuation.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Revenue nearly doubled from a year earlier.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Commercial sales passed government sales for the first time.

stories.background: Palantir is a US data analytics company long known for its government and defense work.

meme.top: Palantir nearly doubled its revenue
meme.bottom: the stock went down a bit
meme.take: Palantir grew 96% and investors reacted like it was a disappointing weather report.

stories.title: OpenAI's new LifeVal benchmark tests AI on everyday chores like childcare and budgets
stories.summary: LifeVal measures whether AI can handle daily tasks such as finding childcare, managing a budget and navigating government paperwork.
stories.why: Most AI tests focus on exams and code, not the errands people actually want help with.
stories.happened: OpenAI says it built the benchmark from time-use studies and a survey of 3,995 people about how they spend their days.
stories.next: Watch for published scores across rival models and whether other labs adopt it.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It targets everyday life tasks rather than expert work.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Labs are racing to show AI agents doing useful real-world work.

stories.background: Benchmarks are standard tests that AI companies use to compare models.

meme.top: AI can pass the bar exam
meme.bottom: now it has to find a babysitter
meme.take: OpenAI has finally built a test as hard as dealing with a government form.

stories.title: A Switch 2 Lite is rumored at about $299 with a 7.1-inch screen
stories.summary: Leaks reported by GameGPU say Nintendo is planning a handheld-only Switch 2 Lite with a smaller screen and a lower price.
stories.why: A cheaper Switch 2 would open the console to many more buyers.
stories.happened: The reported model would have a 7.1-inch screen, versus 7.9 inches on the Switch 2, and no TV output. A removable battery is expected in Europe because of a 2027 law. Nintendo has not announced anything.
stories.next: Watch for any official word from Nintendo, which has not commented.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The original Switch Lite was a popular cheaper option.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $299 price would undercut the standard Switch 2.

stories.background: Nintendo released a handheld-only Switch Lite in 2019, two years after the original Switch.

meme.top: The Switch 2 Lite is rumored
meme.bottom: it is the Switch 2 with less
meme.take: Nintendo's rumored Switch 2 Lite removes the TV, which some families will call a feature.

stories.title: Netflix premieres Bass X Machina, a steampunk anime about lawman Bass Reeves
stories.summary: The six-episode animated series from Yasuke creator LeSean Thomas reimagines US marshal Bass Reeves in a steampunk Old West.
stories.why: It puts a real but long-overlooked Black lawman at the centre of a big-studio sci-fi series.
stories.happened: Brian Tyree Henry voices Reeves, a Civil War veteran with a cybernetic arm, with Janelle Monáe and Tati Gabrielle in the cast. Studio Mir, known for The Legend of Korra, animated it. It premiered November 3.
stories.next: Watch for whether it reaches Netflix's top 10 in its first week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Brian Tyree Henry and Janelle Monáe lead the voice cast.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Netflix keeps investing in adult animated series.

stories.background: Bass Reeves was one of the first Black deputy US marshals west of the Mississippi in the 1800s.

meme.top: A real Old West lawman
meme.bottom: now has a robot arm
meme.take: Netflix gave Bass Reeves steampunk tech, as if his true story was not already enough.

stories.title: Sony is making a Mouthwashing film with director Karyn Kusama
stories.summary: Sony has picked up film rights to the 2024 indie horror game Mouthwashing, with Karyn Kusama set to direct.
stories.why: A small indie hit getting a studio film shows how hungry Hollywood is for game stories.
stories.happened: Sony acquired the rights from developer Wrong Organ and publisher Critical Reflex, Deadline reports. Matt Manfredi and Phil Hay, writers of The Black Phone, will write it. The game follows five crew members stranded at the edge of space.
stories.next: Watch for casting news and a production start date.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Game adaptations keep landing at studios after recent hits.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Kusama directed Jennifer's Body and Destroyer.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The game has overwhelmingly positive reviews on Steam.

stories.background: Mouthwashing is a short psychological horror game released in September 2024.

meme.top: A game about being stuck in space
meme.bottom: is now stuck in development
meme.take: Mouthwashing is getting a film, so its trapped crew now also has to survive Hollywood.
